name: Bjørn Halvorsen
bio:
Bjørn Halvorsen's journey into motorsport finance began unconventionally, not through a lifelong passion for racing, but through a fascination with the complex financial ecosystems that underpin high-performance teams. After graduating with a degree in Economics from the Norwegian School of Economics, he quickly rose through the ranks at a national bank before seeking a more dynamic challenge. The intricate dance of sponsorship deals, budget allocations, and performance-based incentives within motorsport captivated him. 

At Carlin, Bjørn is known for his meticulous approach to financial planning and his ability to identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising performance. He believes in fostering a culture of financial responsibility throughout the team, ensuring that every expenditure contributes directly to on-track success. His colleagues appreciate his direct communication style and his unwavering commitment to fiscal transparency. What sets Bjørn apart is his uncanny ability to predict financial trends and his proactive approach to mitigating risks, making him an invaluable asset to the team's long-term strategic planning.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed to the side with a slight wave
physical.description: Bjørn is a tall man with a serious demeanor and a well-maintained appearance.

quirks: Always carries a small, vintage calculator in his briefcase.
Insists on using physical spreadsheets alongside digital ones for cross-referencing.
